# HAPI v0.35.0.1

## Compared with the previous maintained release

- Rebuilt on official v0.35.0 (06d9e51f5), 772 official commits newer than v0.30.7.7. 49 PRs that v0.30.7.7 carried are now official, including spawn_peer / ping_peer `waitForReply` (#2167) and the runtime heartbeat replay (#2054).
- The old prompt-free session-control layer (#1771, closed upstream) is gone. This fixes worktree spawn failures that reached the web and CLI as `HTTP 502` through Cloudflare (tiann/hapi#2409) and the Hub re-sending StopSession every 5 seconds for sessions whose cleanup failed (tiann/hapi#2408). `hapi stop-peer` and `--remit-id` no longer exist; the `hapi-session-control` skill is still installed with HAPI and now uses `spawn_peer`, `ping_peer` with `waitForReply`, and `inspect_peer`.
- New carries: Hub errors keep their JSON body behind Cloudflare Tunnel (#2423), spawn-peer help says worktree sessions need a Git repository (#2410), and a failed Codex resume can recover even while unrelated wrappers run (#2346). All three were merged officially after v0.35.0 and ship here early.
- No longer carried: closed PRs #1468, #1597, #1607, #1662 and #2080 (official read state replaces it); #2035 (Windows process probes), whose current head needs official runner code newer than v0.35.0; and #1620, #1718, #1721, #1940, #1942, #1944, #1955, #2008, #2026, #2027, #2056, #2099, #2166 and #2342, which conflict with official v0.35.0 or lack a current review.
- Antigravity and session-attached Jobs now come from the official base.
- Hub database: schema 29 becomes 35 on first start, which takes about 10 minutes for a 5 GB database. It is one-way; roll back only with a pre-upgrade backup.

## Compared with the official release

- Rebuilt from official main 06d9e51f5c6a3812ddf84bfdb4782596b392fbf1 (official release v0.35.0), with 19 audited PR carries listed in the release record (5 of them merged officially after v0.35.0).
- Adds session header and machine label cleanups, reasoning-collapse and file-search fixes, optional WxPusher notifications, PWA notification window reuse, composer Enter behavior, fork title generation, typed permission/abort errors, Windows process-probe fixes, Codex shared Web Rewind and inherited fork history sync, and session drag into composer mentions.
- Retains signed macOS CLI artifacts, standalone Linux/Windows CLIs, desktop packages, four-part release gates and a replayable release manifest.

Complete per-PR decisions and personal policy exceptions: tools/maintenance/releases/v0.35.0.1/.
